item.title: How to Build a Brand in 2025: Lessons from Starting a Business While Working Full-Time — Jason Burke
item.description: Learn how I built my brand from scratch while working a full-time job. This step-by-step guide shares actionable tips for starting a business in 2025, from leveraging influencer marketing to perfecting your core products. Discover what I’d do differently and how you can avoid rookie mistakes.

item.title: Why We Discontinued Our Best-Selling Product — Jason Burke
item.description: Our most beloved product had loyal fans and major distribution. But the margins didn’t work. Here’s what we learned from saying no to top-line growth.

item.title: Why Great Branding Won’t Save a Broken CPG Business (+ How to Fix It) — Jason Burke
item.description: Beautiful branding won’t fix bad margins. Learn why most CPG brands bleed cash—and how to build a business engine that actually scales.

item.title: Inside the Mind of a Founder: How to Survive the Chaos of Scaling a Business — Jason Burke
item.description: Discover what it really feels like to run a fast-growing business. From supply chain curveballs to investor pressure, this honest post breaks down the mental chaos of entrepreneurship—and offers 5 practical ways to stay sane while scaling.

item.title: 10 Types of Business Moats (With CPG Brand Examples) to Build Long-Term Competitive Advantage — Jason Burke
item.description: Discover 10 types of business moats that protect your brand from competitors, with real CPG examples. Learn how to leverage brand, community, supply chain, and more to create lasting competitive advantage.

item.title: 13 Lessons from 13 Years of Building a Challenger Brand in CPG — Jason Burke
item.description: After 13 years of building a challenger brand in the CPG industry, here are the hard-earned lessons every founder needs to know. From velocity to cash flow to mental health, these insights will help you scale smarter and survive longer.

item.title: Why Founders Can’t Stop Selling: The Power of Your Story in Building a Brand — Jason Burke
item.description: Founders never stop selling—and that’s your superpower. Learn why your story carries unique weight and how it drives growth and opportunity.

item.title: Lessons From My First Job: How Selling ICEEs Shaped My Entrepreneurial Journey — Jason Burke
item.description: My first job selling ICEEs at Tampa Stadium taught me lessons in hustle, resilience, and adaptability—skills that built The New Primal.

item.title: 7 Hard Truths About Working With Co-Packers Every CPG Founder Must Know — Jason Burke
item.description: Learn the 7 must-know truths about working with co-packers — from hidden costs and communication pitfalls to quality control and scaling risks — before you scale your CPG brand.

item.title: 8 Cheat Codes for Building a CPG Brand Without a Big Budget — Jason Burke
item.description: Building a CPG brand from scratch doesn’t have to drain your wallet. Discover eight proven “cheat codes” for early-stage founders — from using store locators to find wholesale leads, to turning your retail doors into your best marketing channel.
